With world class campuses in Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane, a dedicated team of academics and industry professional lecturers, and the opportunity to participate in international masterclasses, music and songwriting camps and study abroad programs, JMC Academy is committed to ensuring our graduates make their own indelible mark on industry. All JMC bachelor degree graduates are eligible to apply for entry into JMC Academy's Master of Creative Industries, or relevant post-grad qualification at any Australian university.
